description: This file defines an extension method for the `HttpOperationResponse<TList>` type, providing an asynchronous stream (`IAsyncEnumerable`) of watch events from Kubernetes, utilizing channels and a watcher for handling event streaming, cancellation, and exception management.

classes.name: KubernetesClientExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Kubernetes client operations, specifically for watching resources asynchronously.

methods.name: WatchAsync
methods.description: An extension method that streams Kubernetes watch events asynchronously using channels, supporting cancellation and proper resource cleanup.
